name: Run the review from the interface, triage findings and send comments
description:
## Why?

The review has to be startable and its output reviewable from one place, without opening the pull request and without anything reaching the partner unchecked.

## What?

- A **button** on a PR starts the review. Findings appear as pending in the interface. The same button re-runs the review. No automatic trigger on PR open in this round.
- The reviewer goes through the findings, discards the wrong ones, and sends the rest.
- Comments are posted under the `shoptet-addon-reviewer` identity, following our standards — with icons, in English.
- **All comments are handled here. Merge stays in the pull request.**

Triage happens in the interface because that is the only place where the **share of discarded findings** becomes visible — the one signal telling us whether the skill is working or missing the mark.

## Acceptance Criteria

- ☐ A button starts the review on a given PR and produces pending findings
- ☐ Pressing the button again re-runs the review
- ☐ The reviewer can discard individual findings before sending
- ☐ Sending posts the remaining findings as comments on the PR under `shoptet-addon-reviewer`
- ☐ Nothing is sent without the reviewer's action
- ☐ The interface records how many findings were discarded versus sent
- ☐ Comments follow our standard format — icons, English
